headline: Sensex and Nifty end marginally lower in special Muhurat trading session, snapping seven-day rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian stock markets closed marginally lower during the special Muhurat trading session.
The minor dip snapped a seven-day winning streak across Sensex and Nifty.
This marked a rare Diwali drop, closing in the red on Diwali for the first time in years.
Selling pressure in major heavyweights like Bharti Airtel and Infosys weighed on indices.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE held the special Muhurat trading session to mark Diwali Laxmi Pujan and the start of Samvat 2083.
Nifty ended below the 25,000 level in a flat to slightly negative trading session.
Indian equities had previously recorded their best week in six years, bucking a global tech rout.
Market participants are monitoring key domestic and global factors ahead of regular trading on Monday.
summary:
Indian stock markets ended marginally lower during the special Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
The slight dip snapped a seven-day winning rally, bringing Nifty below the 25,000 mark.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys featured among the top losers as market participants prepare for regular trading on Monday.
